title.en: Foreign Exchange–Exchange Rate, NEER & REER, ETF
title.hi: Foreign Exchange–Exchange Rate, NEER & REER, ETF

definition.en: Foreign exchange refers to the mechanism of converting one currency into another, with exchange rates determining the value of one currency against another, while NEER and REER serve as indicators of trade-weighted competitiveness.
definition.hi: Foreign exchange refers to the mechanism of converting one currency into another, with exchange rates determining the value of one currency against another, while NEER and REER serve as indicators of trade-weighted competitiveness.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding exchange rate dynamics is crucial for GS-3 Economy as it directly impacts India's balance of payments, export competitiveness, and inflation. UPSC frequently tests the conceptual clarity of nominal versus real effective exchange rates and the role of ETFs in financial markets.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding exchange rate dynamics is crucial for GS-3 Economy as it directly impacts India's balance of payments, export competitiveness, and inflation. UPSC frequently tests the conceptual clarity of nominal versus real effective exchange rates and the role of ETFs in financial markets.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the mechanics of exchange rate determination and the role of the RBI.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the mechanics of exchange rate determination and the role of the RBI.

learningOutcomes.en: Differentiate between Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) and Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER).
learningOutcomes.hi: Differentiate between Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) and Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER).

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the utility and structure of Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) in the Indian capital market.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the utility and structure of Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) in the Indian capital market.

prerequisites.en: Foreign Capital – FDI, FPI, FII, QFI
prerequisites.hi: Foreign Capital – FDI, FPI, FII, QFI
